results.system: NLLB with LoRA adapters (1.4% of weights trained)
This model: NLLB fine-tuned, both directions

metric: chrF++ on 5,058 held-out sentence pairs (0–100, higher is better)
limitations: Trained on short everyday sentences (4.5 words on average). Long or technical sentences are less reliable.
Small function words like na, kwa and ni are sometimes left in Kiswahili when translating into Kidaw'ida.
Single words without context, such as 'huku' or 'changamoto', are the weakest case.
Kidaw'ida spelling varies between writers, especially apostrophes (w'andu vs wandu).
